text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel came to watch the Satsuki 
Sho. In this whirlwind first leg of the 
Classics, both she and the crowd had their 
eyes fixed squarely on Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian seized victory in the Satsuki 
Sho with overwhelming dominance. The crowd 
erupted into an uproar, and whispers of 
her being the "strongest" began to spread 
like wildfire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel's feelings of admiration 
grew even stronger. An ideal running style 
that could conquer all—something she 
herself currently lacked—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Her desire to surpass that ultimate 
running style and win is boiling fiercely 
within her. She wants to fight in the 
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A race to decide the pinnacle of their 
generation. Sakura Laurel's heart became 
entirely captivated by the Nippon Derby, a 
once-in-a-lifetime race.
